subject: SIG questionnaire — completion roadmap, outstanding artifacts, and gaps
messages:
From: Amy Liao <amy.liao@bluecaphealth.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 3 Nov 2025 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: SIG: Follow-up & artifacts needed for procurement review

Hi Karthik / Laura,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement's next step is the SIG questionnaire and the supporting artifacts we discussed — primarily: SOC 2 report (summary is fine), pen-test summary, ISO statements, and your security slide deck. They asked for a proposed timeline for completion so they can align internal stakeholders.

Can you confirm:
- Whether the SIG has been started/completed by your side
- When we can expect the SOC2 summary, pen-test summary, and the security deck (we'd like to bundle these with the SIG response)
- Any items you anticipate needing our procurement or legal teams to sign off on (NDA, data processing addendum, etc.)

Target for our procurement review: 2025-11-10. Is that feasible?

Appreciate a short roadmap and any links to where artifacts will be shared.

Best,
Amy
Amy Liao
Head of Vendor Risk, BlueCap Health
amy.liao@bluecaphealth.com

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Amy Liao <amy.liao@bluecaphealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 3 Nov 2025 16:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SIG: Follow-up & artifacts needed for procurement review

Amy — thanks for the clear ask. We're on this. Quick summary of next steps below (high-level roadmap):

1) SIG questionnaire (we've started) — target draft to you by 2025-11-05
2) SOC 2 summary (latest public report 2024) — delivery 2025-11-04
3) Pen-test summary (redacted vendor summary) — delivery 2025-11-06; full report available under NDA
4) ISO statements (attestation + scope) — delivery 2025-11-04
5) Security deck (customer-facing, v3) — delivery 2025-11-05

If procurement needs anything sooner we can prioritize the SOC2 and ISO statements first. We'll provide the artifacts via a secure share (link + view-only) and will attach a completed SIG workbook (xlsx) in the follow-up.

One ask from our side: please confirm whether BlueCap requires evidence stored in your vendor portal, or if the secure Drive link is sufficient. Also confirm whether the DPA needs to be signed before we share any redacted pen-test material.

I'll loop in Laura on the SOC2/ISO attestation details — Laura, can you confirm the attestation wording and whether the SOC2 summary needs additional redaction before sharing?

Thanks,
Karthik

--
Karthik Iyer
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: Amy Liao <amy.liao@bluecaphealth.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 4 Nov 2025 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: SIG: Follow-up & artifacts needed for procurement review

Amy — forwarding the artifacts we can share now. Attached are: SOC2-report-2024-summary.pdf, ISO27001-statement-2024.pdf, Redwood-security-deck-v3.pdf, and a completed SIG-questionnaire-completed.xlsx (answers redacted where needed).

Attachments: (stubs)
- SOC2-report-2024-summary.pdf (PDF, 120 KB)
- pen-test-summary-2025.pdf (PDF, 45 KB, redacted)
- ISO27001-statement-2024.pdf (PDF, 28 KB)
- Redwood-security-deck-v3.pdf (PPTX, 2.1 MB)
- SIG-questionnaire-completed.xlsx (XLSX, 210 KB)

Notes:
- The pen test full report contains vendor-sensitive details; it's available under a mutual NDA or on an encrypted portal. If BlueCap needs the full penetration test write-up, please confirm and we will route a redacted copy via DocuSign / secure transfer.
- Fields in the SIG workbook flagged with "Legal review" were left as comments for your counsel; Marissa will follow up on those items.
- For the SOC2, we are sharing the summary attestation and the control coverage table. For procurement needs that require the full report, we'll need a formal request form.

Secure links & actions:
- Artifact bundle (view-only): https://drive.google.com/securelink/redwood/bluecap-evidence
- DocuSign request for NDA/redacted-penetration-report: https://app.docusign.com/links/SIG-ack-78942

Marissa, can you take point on the legal/contract questions and confirm whether DPA signature is required pre-share?

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Director, Information Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Laura / Karthik — received, thanks. The bundle and SIG workbook look good from an initial pass. A couple of quick items before we close the procurement checklist: 

- Procurement will accept the SOC2 summary and ISO attestation as-is.
- Pen-test summary is fine; procurement will request the redacted full report via the DocuSign link for legal review.
- A short call (15 min) to review the "Legal review" comments would be helpful. Can Marissa or someone from Redwood legal be available on Monday 2025-11-10 at 09:00 PT?

If we get the DocuSign NDA request submitted by Friday EOD, procurement can proceed with the risk review next week.

Thanks again — we should be on track to meet our internal 2025-11-10 gate provided the NDA is executed.

Best,
Amy
